purpose: Farm machinery and post-harvest equipment with power class, automation level, AI readiness and the subsidy scheme that applies.
collection_mode: Knowledge synthesis from documented public sources (WebFetch to government domains blocked by environment egress policy)
methodology: Sixteen machinery types spanning land preparation, sowing, crop protection, harvesting, post-harvest, processing, packaging, cold chain, irrigation and monitoring. Scheme attribution is the field of highest practical value and is sourced to the named scheme.
known_limitations: investment_inr, annual_maintenance_inr and most capacity figures are the bare sentinel throughout. Equipment prices are set by manufacturer and model and no single official public figure exists; a plausible number here would be fabrication. Consumers needing costs must obtain current DIC or dealer quotations.
